title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset (CVE-2023-44487): The 398M RPS DDoS Exploit
excerpt: Abusing the HTTP/2 RST_STREAM frame to generate 398 million requests per second. How a protocol-level architectural design flaw crippled edge proxies, CDNs, and web servers worldwide.

title: PaperCut MF/NG (CVE-2023-27350): Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
excerpt: Unauthenticated administrative access via a setup-page bypass, followed by arbitrary remote code execution as SYSTEM. How enterprise print management software became a preferred ransomware entry point.

title: Fortinet FortiOS SSL-VPN CVEs (2022–2024): Heap Overflows & Auth Bypasses
excerpt: Heap-based buffer overflows, XOR byte manipulations, and HTTP header spoofing. How Fortinet FortiGate SSL-VPN appliances became the most targeted edge devices by nation-state actors and ransomware operators.

title: VMware vCenter & ESXi Hypervisor Vulnerabilities (CVE-2023-34048 & CVE-2024-37085)
excerpt: DCE/RPC packet parsing heap overflows and Active Directory ESXi Admins group takeovers. How attackers pivoted from enterprise hypervisor control planes to encrypt entire virtual machine storage clusters.

title: Git Client RCE & Submodule Vulnerabilities (CVE-2022-24765 & CVE-2024-32002)
excerpt: Weaponizing 'git clone' via case-insensitive filesystem confusion and parent directory traversal. How running a simple clone command executed arbitrary shell scripts on developer machines and CI/CD runners.

title: Redis Unauthenticated RCE & Lua Sandbox Escapes (CVE-2022-0543 & Rogue Replication)
excerpt: Escaping the Redis Lua sandbox via Debian package initialization oversights, and weaponizing rogue master replication to drop dynamic C modules on exposed port 6379 instances.

title: GitLab Critical RCE (CVE-2021-22205) & CI/CD Pipeline Exploits
excerpt: CVSS 10.0. Unauthenticated remote code execution in GitLab Community and Enterprise editions via DjVu image format parsing in ExifTool. How CI/CD servers became botnet nodes.

title: TeamCity Auth Bypass & RCE (CVE-2023-42793 & CVE-2024-27198)
excerpt: Path traversal leading to unauthenticated administrative token creation and instant weaponized runner script execution across enterprise JetBrains TeamCity CI/CD servers.

title: BLASTPASS (CVE-2023-4863 & CVE-2023-41064): The libwebp Zero-Click Exploit
excerpt: A heap-based buffer overflow in Google's libwebp library processing lossless WebP images. Delivered with zero clicks via iMessage to deploy Pegasus spyware, and affecting every browser, electron app, and image resizing service.

title: Laravel Ignition RCE (CVE-2021-3129): Exploiting PHP Debug Pages in Production
excerpt: CVSS 9.8. How leaving debug mode enabled in Laravel exposed the Ignition error handler to insecure deserialization and unauthenticated remote code execution via PHP phar wrappers.

title: GoAnywhere MFT Remote Code Execution (CVE-2023-0669): Zero-Day Deserialization
excerpt: CVSS 7.2. Insecure Java object deserialization in the License Response Servlet. How Cl0p ransomware compromised over 130 healthcare and enterprise organizations in a single zero-day blitz.

title: Zenbleed (CVE-2023-20593) & Downfall (CVE-2022-40982): CPU Microarchitectural Flaws
excerpt: Stealing 30 KB/sec per core across virtual machines. How Zenbleed (AMD Zen 2) and Downfall (Intel AVX) broke CPU hardware isolation boundaries to leak encryption keys and memory across multi-tenant clouds.

title: Postman & Git Credentials Leakage: API Token Security in Cloud Architectures
excerpt: How public workspaces, hardcoded .env files in Git commits, and insecure Postman environment syncs leak production Shopify, Stripe, and AWS API keys to automated scrapers in seconds.

title: SonicWall SonicOS SSL-VPN CVEs (2021–2024): Memory Corruption & Ransomware
excerpt: Improper resource management and unauthenticated stack-based buffer overflows in SonicWall SonicOS. How Akira and Fog ransomware cartels weaponized edge firewall vulnerabilities.

title: Juniper Junos OS J-Web RCE Chain (CVE-2023-36844 to 36847): PHP Environment Injection
excerpt: CVSS 9.8. Chaining unauthenticated environment variable manipulation with arbitrary file uploads in Juniper Networks SRX firewalls and EX switches to gain root access.

title: Exim & Roundcube Mail Infrastructure Exploits (CVE-2023-42115 & CVE-2023-43770)
excerpt: Memory corruption in Exim Mail Transfer Agents and stored XSS in Roundcube webmail rendering. How enterprise mail delivery pipelines and webmail portals were compromised by advanced threat groups.
